correctness.rationale: Exact rational substitution proves the positive equilibrium of printed (5.1). The delayed infection Jacobian has determinant zero, so the characteristic determinant is affine in \(e^{-\lambda\tau_1}\). Exact reconstruction gives the stated \(P,Q\), positive zero-delay Hurwitz determinants, and a modulus polynomial \(F(u)\) with \(F(0)<0\) and \(F'(u)>0\) for every \(u>0\). Thus there is one positive imaginary frequency. Phase reconstruction gives the first positive crossing \(\tau_{1,*}=13.87960223606146\ldots\); direct implicit differentiation gives positive crossing speed. The packaged standard-library verifier replays all critical computations.
